name: krafty-sprouts/pollen
label: Pollen
description: Shares your content to social networks when it is published. It sends only to the channels you connect, and tracks no readers.

settingsSections.label: Getting started
settingsSections.description: Pollen keeps each channel's sign-in sealed with this key. Set it once, before you connect any channel.

settingsSections.label: Sharing
settingsSections.description: How shares are written, timed and tagged.

settings.label: Lock key
settings.description: A long phrase, at least 24 characters, that seals channel sign-ins. Changing it later means connecting every channel again.

settings.label: Share text
settings.description: What a share says. Use {title}, {excerpt}, {content}, {link}, {author}, {hashtags}, {categories}, {tags}, {site} and {type}.

settings.label: Text for each network
settings.description: Write differently for a network. A network not listed uses the share text above. A channel's own text comes before both.

fields.label: Network
fields.description: The network this text is for.

settings.label: Most hashtags
settings.description: How many of an item's categories and tags become hashtags.

settings.label: Wait after publishing
settings.description: Minutes Pollen waits after an item is published before sharing it, so a quick fix makes it in.

settings.label: Tag shared links
settings.description: Add utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign to each shared link, so your own statistics can tell where readers came from.

settings.label: Pause all sharing
settings.description: While on, nothing is sent; shares wait and go when it is off again.

author: Krafty Sprouts Media, LLC
